newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates higher to steady.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates higher to steady.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were higher to steady in line with the trend in the money market, traders said on Monday.
"It's still at the same levels because overnight rates are high," said a local bank dealer.

Overnight money rose to an average of 14.5625 percent on Monday from 14.53125. Dealers said banks are beefing up their peso liquidity positions in anticipation of the seasonal tightness during the Christmas season.
PHIBOR represents rates at which banks are willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
